title: A repository cleanup deletes the home directory
summary: A developer asked Claude Code to clean up an old repository. The delete command listed three project folders and then the home folder as a fourth argument. The shell did exactly what it was told and the Mac lost its user data. The post drew wide attention. Claude Code today has a built-in check that asks before removing a home or root folder.
lesson: One extra argument was enough. The check has to read every argument of every delete, in every form the command can take.

sources.title: Docker: Coding agent horror stories, the rm -rf incident
